messages.subject: Error term for spatial autocorrelation
parts:
Dear Unmarked users and developers-

Is there any way of including an error term for spatial
autocorrelation (among sampling sites) in abundance or occupancy
models?

Thanks for your input and time. Best regards,

Matt

messages.subject: Re: [unmarked] Error term for spatial autocorrelation
parts:
hi Matt,
 there are no models in unmarked that allow for spatial autocorrelation.  This would require a rather major technological retooling and it seems unlikely to happen in the near term.
regards
andy

messages.subject: RE: [unmarked] Error term for spatial autocorrelation
parts:
hi Matt,

yes, there is, but you would have to code that yourself, for instance using WinBUGS. For code examples in the context of site-occ models see a book chapter in Royle & Dorazio (2008) as well as an upcoming paper in Ecol.Appl. by Florent Bled et al.

Regards -- Marc
